messages:
maria: Quick FYI — ACME legal asked for pdf-export feature to be enabled only for acme-corp and partner_acct until their PII review is done. Need owner for allowlist + canary. @jordan? :eyes:

jordan: I can take config. Are we creating a per-customer flag or using contract-gated toggle? What's the TTL on the exception?

maria: Contract gating preferred. Exemption window 30 days starting TOMORROW. They need admin access to opt new subaccounts. No code changes to product paths.

lee: For contract gating we'll need an entry in the customer_entitlements table and a toggle slice. I'll need the exact org id(s). maria: acme-corp -> org: 7892, partner_acct -> org: 8890.

jordan: Cool. Plan: create feature flag `pdf_export_v2` with a contract exception slice + allowlist. I'll push a canary that targets those org ids only. Anyone object to disabling rollout elsewhere?

anne: SRE: Make sure there's a kill-switch route and circuit-breaker for token storms. Also add a monitoring alert for error rate and latency spike during canary.

sam: I'll handle allowlist provisioning in the dashboard and add ACME as a customer-scoped entitlement. Need exact rollout time window.

maria: Start canary at 2026-03-19 06:00 PT. Emergency rollback within first 30 minutes if >2% error or any auth failures. :warning:

jordan: I'll create the flag config now. Draft config:
```
flag: pdf_export_v2
slices:
  - name: acme-contract-exception
    type: allowlist
    ids: [7892, 8890]
  - name: default
    rollout: 0%
canary_window: 30m
kill_switch: /flags/pdf_export_v2/disable
```

jordan: Pushing PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/flags/pulls/412

lee: I'll update infra to accept the `allowlist` slice and wire the auth check. ETA 2 hours.

toggle-bot: deploy queued for `eng-platform` -> environments: staging, canary

anne: Ops checklist: create pager for pdf-export-high-error, add synthetic test that generates a sample pdf export, ensure logs have org_id in structured payload.

sam: I provisioned ACME in dashboard. Confirmed UI shows toggle for org 7892 and 8890.

maria: Thanks. Jordan, please post when PR merges and when canary starts. I'll loop legal on the rollback plan.

jordan: PR merged at 2387660000. Canary start scheduled at 2387663600. Will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

maria: Perfect. Leaving this as the single source of truth for the handoff. If anything changes ping #eng-oncall and @anne.
